g.text: The rule that survives every check: a target is safe only if it is BOTH confined to few normal cell types AND those cell types are expendable.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #5a6473

g.text: Human Protein Atlas single-cell consensus, 154 cell types. Outcome labels are clinical safety history only and are frozen in target_labels.py. Full panel: separation 0.868, permutation p = 0.0003 (n = 19 vs 10).
